## Session A · 2:05–3:15

We start where every design meeting from here starts. At the graph. Conditioning on observables, drawn: which back doors a set of controls closes, and the one you cannot see well enough to close. Then controls and matching in practice, and when a regression coefficient can be read causally. 'I added controls' is a claim about the graph, not a technique. The rest of the session is what would have to be true for that claim to hold.
